provider: Jina AI embeddings and reranker API
category: embedding and rerank API, one-time free token balance on an auto-generated key

free_tier.stated: an auto-generated API key carries free tokens usable across every Jina model (embeddings, reranker, reader, classifier, segmenter). The first-party pages state no token amount; a third-party catalogue reports 10M tokens per new key, one-time. When the tokens are spent the key needs a purchased top-up
free_tier.notes: unverified: the 10M figure rests on the third-party catalogue only; the vendor pages read say 'free tokens' with no number

tooling: any HTTP client or the OpenAI-schema-compatible /v1/embeddings call; /v1/rerank takes a query and a document list; /v1/batch/embeddings takes JSONL for large jobs
chaining: the same key and balance also pay for Reader (r.jina.ai) and Search (s.jina.ai); embeddings from here pair with the rerank endpoint of the same key as a second stage

limits.value: free tokens on the key, shared by every Jina API on that key; amount unstated on the vendor pages read, a third-party catalogue reports 10M tokens one-time

Free key: 100 requests and 100,000 tokens per minute on /v1/embeddings and /v1/rerank per the product pages (https://jina.ai/embeddings/, https://jina.ai/reranker/); the API reference at https://docs.jina.ai/ states 500 requests and 1,000,000 tokens per minute for the same endpoints; both pages are current and disagree; a per-IP limit of 10,000 requests per 60 seconds also applies; excess answers HTTP 429

identity_cost.detail: a key is auto-generated for a new user and the vendor only recommends logging in to keep it; unverified: whether the key page asks for any field before it issues the key, and the key page is a browser app that the page reader returned empty

reliability_note: the vendor's post-acquisition notice states the embeddings and reranker APIs continue to be developed and maintained; the free tokens do not renew
confidence_note: the free key, both rate-limit pairs and the model ids are quoted from vendor pages; the token amount is unverified at the vendor (third-party figure only) and the two rate-limit pairs disagree between vendor pages.

evidence.quote: Yes. New users get an auto-generated API key with free tokens usable across any of our models. Once the free tokens are consumed, you can purchase additional tokens for the key in the 'Buy tokens' tab.
evidence.proved: a new user gets an auto-generated key carrying free tokens that work across every Jina model; the first-party page states no token amount

evidence.quote: Rate limits depend on your API key type: Free: 100 RPM, 100K TPM Paid: 500 RPM, 2M TPM Premium: 5,000 RPM, 50M TPM There is an additional IP-based limit of 10,000 requests per 60 seconds to prevent abuse.
evidence.proved: a free key is limited to 100 requests and 100,000 tokens per minute, with an additional per-IP limit of 10,000 requests per 60 seconds

evidence.quote: | Embedding API | `https://api.jina.ai/v1/embeddings` | Convert text/images to fixed-length vectors |  | 100 RPM & 100,000 TPM |
evidence.proved: the embeddings product page gives a free key 100 requests and 100,000 tokens per minute on /v1/embeddings

evidence.quote: | Reranker API | `https://api.jina.ai/v1/rerank` | Rank documents by query |  | 100 RPM & 100,000 TPM |
evidence.proved: the reranker product page gives a free key 100 requests and 100,000 tokens per minute on /v1/rerank

evidence.quote: | `/v1/embeddings` | 500 RPM · 1M TPM | 500 RPM · 10M TPM | 5,000 RPM · 100M TPM |

evidence.quote: It's recommended to log in to keep your API key securely stored and easily accessible.
evidence.proved: logging in is recommended and not stated as required to hold a key

evidence.quote: Authentication. Send `Authorization: Bearer `. Get a key at https://jina.ai/?sui=apikey.
evidence.proved: every embeddings and rerank call needs a bearer key, obtained from the key page

evidence.quote: | [Jina AI](https://aifree.dev/offer/jina-ai-free-api-tokens) | 10M tokens per new API key, shared across Embeddings, Reranker, Reader, Classifier and Segmenter | jina-embeddings-v5-text-small and v5-omni-small (32K) | jina-reranker-v3.5 | No | One-time |

evidence.proved: the vendor states the embeddings and reranker APIs continue to be served after the acquisition

binding_note: the one-time free token balance runs out before any rate limit matters: at the lower rate (100,000 tokens per minute) 10M tokens would take 100 minutes
notes: models on the keyless list include jina-embeddings-v5-text-small, v5-text-nano, v5-omni-small, v5-omni-nano, jina-embeddings-v4 and v3, jina-code-embeddings-0.5b and 1.5b, jina-clip-v2, jina-colbert-v2, and the rerankers jina-reranker-v3.5, v3, m0 and v2-base-multilingual
